g.text: FOLIO 01 / FIRST RECORDED IN THE LANTERN GROVE
“It keeps the warmth of old maps.”
Habitat: lantern groves near old paper.
One more bond reveals a variant
for encounters in a future run.

svg.text: First defeat or bond adds a real entry.
Bonding reveals skills and advances research.
The Book counts discoveries, not empty slots.
